info.description: The API recommends sentences to be added or removed from a given input prompt to make it more responsible.
info.title: Responsible Prompt Recommendation API

get.description: Given an input prompt with one or more sentences, returns up to five recommendations of sentences and its respective positive value representations to be added at the end of the input prompt, and up to five recommendations for removal of potentially harmful sentences in the given input prompt.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Provide an input prompt that would be sent to an LLM. Note that this recommendation is performed at prompting time and this API is not generating content. It uses a curated dataset of values and prompts to compute the similarity to the input sentences provided and the dataset sentences. Please note that similarity informed is cosine similarity. Please note that the index informed in the removal recommendations is 0-indexed.

parameters.name: add_lower_threshold
parameters.description: The lower threshold is used to select centroids of sentences based on the similarity of the provided input and the centroid of existing clusters of sentences based on values. The default value for the lower threshold is 0.3

parameters.name: add_upper_threshold
parameters.description: The upper sentence threshold is being used as a ceiling value to avoid redundance, meaning that we will not recommend adding something that is already there. The default value for the upper threshold is 0.5

parameters.name: remove_lower_threshold
parameters.description: The lower threshold is used to select centroids of sentences based on the similarity of the provided input and the centroid of existing clusters of sentences based on values.. The default value for the lower removal threshold is 0.3

parameters.name: remove_upper_threshold
parameters.description: An upper removal threshold limit is used to prevent false positives and remove a sentence in the prompt similar to one of our adversarial prompts. The default value for the upper removal threshold is 0.5

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: The model id to be used. The default choice is: sentence-transformers/all-minilm-l6-v2

get.summary: Function that recommends thresholds given an array of prompts
get.description: Given an input array of prompts, returns thresholds for a selected model.

parameters.name: prompts
parameters.description: One or more prompt samples used to estimate recommendation thresholds. Repeat this query parameter to provide multiple prompts.
example: Act as a data scientist. Help me make this project more inclusive.
What evidence should I gather to support my request for more resources?

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: The local model path or Hugging Face model id to be used. If omitted, the default local model path is ./models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/.

get.summary: Obtain a response to the user query from LLMs hosted on HuggingFace.
get.description: Given an input prompt, returns the response from text completion using LLMs hosted on HuggingFace.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text input used to generate a response.

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: The id from HuggingFace of the LLM to be accessed. The default choice is: meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct

parameters.name: max_new_tokens
parameters.description: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a response

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

404.description: invalid input parameters or model unavailable
